followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the January 2018 Kerem Shalom commercial closure, supported by onset reporting and a subsequent actual reopening report. Preserve commercial goods, fuel and aid from Israel into Gaza. This freight endpoint does not date passenger movement at other Gaza crossings. Retain 14–16 January 2018 and a two-calendar-day difference. The 15 January planned reopening is corroborated by WAFA’s 16 January completed-reopening account, but exact hours remain unknown. Retain Security / Public order and immediate safety as the IDF’s stated crossing-safety purpose. Tunnel and responsibility claims remain attributed. The IDF statement and Times of Israel army report share an official source family; WAFA supplies the distinct later commercial-return report. No extra independent origin is claimed for repetition of the army plan. Retain unlocated Kerem Shalom commercial-crossing scope with null coordinates. No Erez/Rafah passenger marker, all-Gaza closure or location for the tunnel is inferred.
